nodes.label: Debounce (default 3s)
nodes.rationale: Waits until file activity stops before triggering a rebuild, so a wave of parallel agent writes triggers one rebuild instead of one per file.

nodes.label: calls edge direction + single-language rule
nodes.rationale: source must be the caller and target the callee, never reversed; calls edges must stay within one language because cross-language call edges are phantom artifacts.

nodes.label: Discrete confidence_score rubric
nodes.rationale: Fixed discrete values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) instead of a continuous range, because production data showed models collapse continuous guidance into a bimodal 0.5/0.85+ split; discrete rubrics are followed more faithfully.

nodes.label: Node ID format ({full_path_stem}_{entity})
nodes.rationale: Uses every directory level (not just the immediate parent) so same-named files in different directories don't collide, and must match the AST extractor's ID scheme exactly or it creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Constrained query vocab expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify query matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming/synonyms/cross-language matching, so a wording mismatch between the user's question and the graph's labels collapses the answer to noise; expanding the query against the graph's own extracted vocabulary (never inventing tokens) fixes this before traversal.

nodes.label: graphify reflect / LESSONS.md (self-improving loop)
nodes.rationale: save-result outcomes (useful/dead_end/corrected) accumulate into LESSONS.md listing preferred sources, known dead ends, and corrections, so later sessions reuse what worked instead of re-deriving it; --if-stale keeps refresh cost near zero when the commit hook already regenerated it.

nodes.label: graphify.build.build_merge()
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction (calls/implements/imports) is always preserved (#801); every source_file in the new chunk is dropped from the base before merge so replace-on-re-extract reconciles changed files (#1344) without needing to also prune 'changed' files (which would wrongly delete freshly re-extracted content, #1178 moot).

nodes.label: Manifest stamping (only mark files that actually produced output)
nodes.rationale: A changed doc/paper/image whose chunk failed or was omitted must stay unstamped so the next --update re-queues it; otherwise it is marked done and its content is lost forever (#2015). Dispatched-but-not-stamped files also have their stale semantic_hash cleared so detect_incremental doesn't read them as unchanged (#1948).
nodes.norm_label: manifest stamping (only mark files that actually produced output)

nodes.label: Shrink guard (#479): refuse to write a smaller graph.json
nodes.rationale: to_json() returns False instead of writing when the new graph has fewer nodes than the existing graph.json, so a partial/failed extraction can never silently clobber a good prior graph; GRAPH_REPORT.md and the analysis sidecar are only written after a successful (non-shrinking) export.
nodes.norm_label: shrink guard (#479): refuse to write a smaller graph.json

nodes.label: Multi-subfolder / monorepo merge flow
nodes.rationale: The skill pipeline always writes to graphify-out/ in the cwd, so running it per-subfolder would clobber the same output dir; the CLI's graphify extract is used per subfolder instead so each gets its own graphify-out/ before merge-graphs combines them.

nodes.label: Whisper domain-hint prompt (from god node labels)
nodes.rationale: The agent is already an LLM, so it composes a one-sentence domain hint itself from the corpus's god-node labels and feeds it to Whisper as the initial prompt, rather than making a separate API call.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge, never skip the corpus-size warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores, never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning - an explicit anti-hallucination/transparency contract for the whole pipeline.
